verses.text: Iri ni ijambo Uhoraho yatumye kuri Yoweli mwene Petuweli.
Nimwumve ibi, yemwe batware; nimwumvirize, yemwe ababa mu gihugu mwese. Mbega hari ikintu nk’iki cari bwigere kiba kuva aho mwabereyeho, canke kuva aho ba sogokuruza banyu babereyeho?
Nimubibwire abana banyu, n’abana banyu bazobibwire abana babo, n’abana babo bazobibwire urunganwe ruzokurikira.
Ivyo inzige zisanzwe zasigaje, inzige nininini zarabiriye; ivyo inzige nininini zasigaje, ivyana vy’inzige vyarabiriye Ivyo ivyana vy’inzige vyasigaje, izindi nzige zarabiriye.
Nimwikangure, yemwe mborerwa mwe, maze murire! Nimuboroge, yemwe mwa banywi b’umuvinyu mwe; muboroge, kubera umuvinyu mushasha, muwukuwe mu kanwa.
Ihanga riteye igihugu canje, ingabo z’inkomezi zitoharurika; bafise amenyo nk’ay’intare, n’imibangabanga nk’iy’intare y’ingore.
Bahoneje inzabibu zanje kandi barandaguye imisukoni yanje. Barabishishaguye, babishiburira hirya, basiga amashami yera.
Nimugandare nk’inkumi yambaye igunira iririra umusore yari ayikoye.
Amashikanwa y’ifu n’ay’ibinyobwa araciwe mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho . Abaherezi baragandaye, ari bo bakorera imbere y’ Uhoraho .
Imirima irarandaguwe, isi iragadutse; ingano zirahonye, umutobe w’umuvinyu urakamye, n’amavuta ya elayo arabuze.
Nimwihebure, yemwe barimyi, muboroge yemwe barimyi b’imizabibu; mubabare kubera ingano na sayiri, kuko ivyimburwa vyo mu mirima bisanganguwe.
Umuvinyu urakamye umusukoni urakabiranye; amakomamanga, ibigazi n’amapome, n’ibiti vyose vy’ivyamwa birumye. Ni ukuri umunezero w’abantu uraheze.

Nimwambare amagunira, yemwe baherezi, maze mugandare; nimuboroge, yemwe abakorera imbere y’igicaniro. Nimuze mumare ijoro mwambaye amagunira, yemwe abakorera imbere y’Imana yanje; kuko amashikanwa y’ifu n’ay’ibinyobwa bibuze mu Ngoro y’Imana yanyu.
Nimwamamaze ukwisonzesha kwera; nimutumeko ikoraniro ryera. Nimutumeko abatware n’ababa mu gihugu bose ngo baze ku Ngoro y’ Uhoraho Imana yanyu, maze batakambire Uhoraho .
Ewe musi uri aho! Uwo umusi w’ Uhoraho uri hafi; uzoza nk’icago gihonya uvuye ku Mana ihambaye.
Mbega ivyokurya ntivyakuweho imbere y’amaso yanyu, n’umunezero no guhimbarwa biva ku nzu y’Imana yacu?
Imbuto zumiye mu kuzimu. Ibigega bisigaye ari imisaka, ububiko bw’ingano bwarasambuwe, kuko ingano zaheze.
Ibitungwa biraniha. Amasho arasanzaye hirya no hino; kuko abuze uburagiro; n’imikuku y’intama n’impene ishikiwe n’ivyago.
Uhoraho , ni wewe ntakambiye, kuko umuriro watongoye uburagiro bwo mu bugaragwa n’ibirimi vy’umuriro vyatongoye ibiti vyo mu murima.
N’ibikoko vyo mw’ishamba bihuzagizwa bikurondera; amasoko y’amazi yakamye, umuriro na wo watongoye uburagiro bwo mu bugaragwa.

headings.text: Akamo gatewe abantu ngo bacure intimba

verses.text: Nimuvuze inzamba i Siyoni; muvuze akamo k’intambara ku musozi wanje wera. Ababa mu gihugu nibahinde agashitsi, kuko umusi w’ Uhoraho ushitse. Uregereje uri hafi,
umusi w’umwijima w’umuzitanya, umusi w’ibicu n’umuzimagiza. Nk’uko umutwenzi uza ku misozi ni ko ingabo z’inkomezi nyinshi zije, ntivyari bwabe muri kahise kandi ntibizosubira kubaho muri kazoza.
Imbere yabo umuriro uratongora, inyuma yabo imbeya zirarabagiza. Imbere yabo igihugu kimeze nk’itongo rya Edeni, inyuma yabo, ni ubugaragwa, nta na kimwe basigaza.
Bafise ishusho y’amafarasi; biruka nk’abagwanira ku mafarasi.
Urwamo rwabo ni nk’urw’imikogote Basimbagurika ku dutwe tw’imisozi, bameze nk’umuriro utongora isakamburira, ni nk’ingabo z’inkomezi zigiye mu ntambara.
Imbere yabo, amahanga ahinda agashitsi; mu maso h’abantu bose harahindurira.
Batera nk’abahizi; burira inzitiro nk’abasoda. Bose bagenda ku murongo, nta n’umwe ahesha ngo aje ku ruhande.
Nta n’umwe agunda mugenziwe; umwe wese agenda aramirije imbere yiwe; binjira baciye mu mpome nta kibatangira.
Bitera mu gisagara; biruka inyuma y’uruzitiro. Barurira bakitera mu mazu; binjira baciye mu madirisha kurya kw’ibisuma.
Imbere yabo isi iratigita, n’amajuru agahinda agashitsi izuba n’ukwezi bicuze umwijima, n’inyenyeri ntizicaka.
Uhoraho araturagaye ari imbere y’ingabo ziwe; ingabo ziwe ntiziharurika, kandi ingabo zimuyoboka ni inyenkomezi. Umusi w’ Uhoraho urahambaye; ni umusi wo guhonya. Ni nde azoshobora kuwihanganira?
“Mbere n’ubu nyene,” ni ko Uhoraho avuze, “nimungarukeko n’umutima wanyu wose, mwisonzesha, murira kandi mugandaye.”

Imitima yanyu nibe ari yo mutabura mureke impuzu zanyu. Nimugaruke k’ Uhoraho Imana yanyu, kuko ari umunyabuntu agira imbabazi, ateba kuraka kandi agira urukundo rwinshi, kandi arigarura ngo ntarungike ivyago.
Hari uwubizi? Ashobora kwigarura akabasigarana umugisha w’amashikanwa y’amafu n’ay’ibinyobwa mushikanira Uhoraho Imana yanyu.
Nimuvuze inzamba i Siyoni, nimuhamagarire abantu ukwisonzesha kwera, mukoranye ikoraniro ryera.
Nimukoranye abantu, mugire ikoraniro ryera; nimukoranye abakurambere, egeranya abana, mukoranye n’abakiri kw’ibere. Uwarongoye nasohoke n’umugeni ave mu nkinga.

Abaherezi bakorera imbere y’ Uhoraho , nibaririre hagati y’urwinjiriro n’igicaniro. Nibavuge bati: “Ziguriza abantu bawe, yewe Uhoraho . Ntuhindure umugabane wawe agatwengo, canke akamenyo hagati mu mahanga. Ni kubera iki mu mahanga bobaza bati: ‘Mbega Imana yabo iri hehe?’ ”
Maze Uhoraho agirira urukundo rwinshi igihugu ciwe kandi agirira akagongwe abantu biwe.
Uhoraho arabishura ati: “Nzobarungikira ingano, umutobe musha w’umuvinyu n’amavuta ya elayo, bikwiye vyo kubahaza; sinzokwongera kubahindura agatwengo mu mahanga.

Nzokwirukana abansi banyu bo mu buraruko baje kure y’aho muri, ndabahindagize gushika mu gihugu kigadutse c’ubugaragwa. Umuce wabo wo mu buseruko nzowirukanira mu Kiyaga c’Umunyu, maze umuce wo mu burengero ndawurungike mu Kiyaga Mediterane. Kandi ukubora kwabo kuzomenyekana n’ukunuka kw’imivyimba yabo kuzoduga mu kirere.” Koko yakoze ibikomeye!
Ntimutinye, yemwe ababa i Buyuda; nimunezerwe kandi muhimbarwe. Ni ukuri Uhoraho yakoze ibikomeye!
Ntimutinye, yemwe bikoko vyo mw’ishamba, kuko uburagiro bwo mu bugaragwa butanguye gutotahara. Ibiti biriko birama ivyamwa vyavyo; imisukoni n’imizabibu vyama ivyimburwa vyavyo.
Nimunezerwe, bantu b’i Siyoni, nimunezererwe Uhoraho Imana yanyu, kuko yabahaye imvura y’impeshi abitewe n’uko ari umwizigirwa. Abaha imvura nyinshi, yo ku mpeshi n’iyo mu rushana, nk’uko vyahora.
Imbuga zizokwuzura ingano; amato azosesekara imitobe y’umuvinyu n’amavuta.
“Nzogushumbusha imyaka yariwe n’inzige; inzige nininini n’abana b’inzige, hamwe n’ubundi bwoko bw’inzige, ari zo ngabo zanje zihambaye, izo narungitse muri mwebwe.
Muzoronka umusesekara w’ivyokurya, muhage, kandi muzohimbaza izina ry’ Uhoraho Imana yanyu, yakoreye ibitangaza muri mwebwe; kandi abantu banje ntibazosubira kumaramara.
Ni ho muzomenya ko ndi mu Bisirayeli, ko ndi Uhoraho Imana yanyu, kandi ko ata yindi iriho; abantu banje ntibazokwigera basubira kumaramara.
Kandi hanyuma y’ivyo, nzosuka Mpwemu wanje ku bantu bose. Abahungu banyu n’abakobwa banyu bazovugishwa, abatama banyu bazorota indoto, n’abasore banyu bazobona ivyo beretswe.
N’abasavyi banje, abagabo n’abagore, nzobasukako Mpwemu wanje muri iyo misi.
Nzokwerekana ibimenyetso mw’ijuru no kw’isi, amaraso n’umuriro n’ugupfunduka kw’umwotsi.
Izuba rizohinduka umwijima, ukwezi guhinduke guse n’amaraso imbere y’uko uwo musi uhambaye w’agatikizo kandi w’ Uhoraho ushika.
Kandi umuntu wese azokwambaza izina ry’ Uhoraho azokizwa; kuko ku musozi Siyoni n’i Yerusalemu hazoba ugutabarwa, nk’uko Uhoraho yavuze, mbere no mu bazoba barokotse ivyago abo Uhoraho azohamagara.”
“Muri iyo misi no muri ico gihe, aho nzogarukanira Abayuda n’ab’i Yerusalemu,

nzokwegeranya amahanga yose ndayakoranirize mu kiyaya ca Yehoshafati. Aho ni ho nzobageragereza kubera ivyo bakoreye umugabane wanje, ari bo bantu banje b’Abisirayeli, kuko basanzaje abantu banje mu mahanga bakagabura igihugu canje.
Bagize ubupfindo ku bantu banje; bagurisha abahungu ngo baronke ba maraya, bakagurisha abakobwa kugira ngo baronke umuvinyu ukwiye wo kunywa.
None ga Tiro na Sidoni munyagiriza iki, mwe n’intara ziri kumwe namwe z’i Bufilisitiya? Mbega munyihora ico nabakoreye? Nimwaba muriko muranyihora, nzobasubizako vuba kandi vyihuta ivyo mwakoze.
Kuko mwafashe ifeza zanje n’inzahabu zanje, mugatwara ivyarusha ibindi kuba vyiza mu butunzi bwanje mubijana mu ngoro zanyu.
Mwagurishije abantu banje b’i Buyuda n’i Yerusalemu ku Bagiriki, kugira ngo mubarungike kure y’igihugu cabo.
Raba, ngiye kubavyura ndabakure aho mwabagurishije hose, kandi nzosubiza kuri mwebwe nyene ivyo mwakoze.
Nzogurisha abahungu banyu n’abakobwa banyu ku bantu b’i Buyuda, maze na bo bazobagurisha ku Basabeya, ihanga rya kure.” Ni ko Uhoraho avuze.
Nimubimenyeshe mu mahanga: Nimwitegurire intambara! Kangura abahizi! Abagwanyi bose nibegere hafi batere.
Ivyuma birima vy’imikogote yanyu mubicuremwo inkota imihoro yanyu muyicuremwo amacumu. Umunyantegenke avuge ati: “Ndakomeye!”
Nimuze munyaruka, yemwe mahanga mwese muve mu mpande zose, mukoranireyo. Manukana abagwanyi bawe, ewe Uhoraho !
“Amahanga navyuke; yose aje mu kiyaya ca Yehoshafati, kuko aho ari ho nzokwicara maze ncire imanza amahanga yose yo mu mpande zose.
Bangura umuhoro, kuko iyimbura rigeze. Nimuze, mugane inzabibu, kuko ubwato bwuzuye kandi ubwato bwo kuganiramwo bukaba busesekaye, ibibi vyabo ni vyinshi!”
Ibihumbi n’ibihumbi bari mu kiyaya c’imanza! Kuko umusi w’ Uhoraho uri hafi mu kiyaya c’imanza.
Izuba n’ukwezi bizokwirabura nk’umwijima, kandi n’inyenyeri ntizizoba zigikayangana.
Uhoraho azokwivuga ari i Siyoni kandi azoturagara ari i Yerusalemu; isi n’amajuru bizohinda agashitsi. Ariko Uhoraho azobera abantu biwe ubuhungiro, umunara wo guhungiramwo w’Abisirayeli.
“Ni ho muzomenyera ko jewe, Uhoraho Imana yanyu, mba i Siyoni, umusozi wanje wera. Yerusalemu hazoba ahera; abanyamahanga ntibazosubira kuhatera.
Kuri uwo musi imisozi izotembako umutobe w’umuvinyu, n’uturambi tuzotembako ubuki; imyonga yose y’i Buyuda itembemwo amazi. Isoko izotemba iva mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho kandi izovomera ikiyaya c’iminyinya.
Ariko Egiputa hazoba umusaka, Edomu habe ubugaragwa, kubera ibibi bakoreye abantu b’i Buyuda, igihugu basheshemwo amaraso y’abatagira icaha.
I Buyuda n’i Yerusalemu hazoba abantu ibihe vyose uko urunganwe ruzokurikirana n’urundi.
Sinzoshirwa ntahoye amaraso y’abatagira icaha. Haba na mba.” Uhoraho ahangamye i Siyoni!
